title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.08483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve

translated_title: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现与优化的潜在空间智能体集群
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）引导的进化搜索利用AI智能体，通过迭代优化解法并融合高分方法，来改进解决数学与计算问题的程序。然而，这一过程往往很缓慢，因为LLM在每一轮都需要生成长篇的文本思维链，且为保持种群多样性必须多次重复这种生成。我们提出了SwarmEvolve框架：每轮由数百个低成本智能体以集群（swarm）方式协作，在潜在空间中直接推理而无需解码为文本，并通过传递KV缓存来共享信息。每个集群从不同角度研究问题；新颖性过滤器通过直接测量智能体隐藏状态向量之间的距离，保留最独特的智能体想法；想法的交叉在潜在空间中自然发生，因为一个总结者智能体会接收所有集群成员合并后的KV缓存。在21个数学发现与科学计算问题上，SwarmEvolve……
tldr: SwarmEvolve让每轮数百个低成本智能体在潜在空间中以集群方式推理、并通过KV缓存共享信息，从而大幅加速LLM引导的进化搜索，在21个数学发现与科学计算问题上表现出色。
